summaryJa: 1957年9月5日および6日早朝（Z時間で約1215Z〜1230Zの間）、カリフォルニア州アップランド付近で市民James S. Hilbeが未確認飛行物体を2夜にわたり目撃した旨、米空軍第15航空軍本部がAF Form 112/112Aで報告している。目撃は地上から肉眼で行われ、物体は各日とも1個、形状・大きさ・色は不明、尾や噴流なし、音の報告なしと記載されている。高度は約2,000フィートと記載されるが、速度・方向・機動性などは不明。物的証拠はなく、情報は不十分で分析に足りないとされる。報告は関係部署（ADC、SAC、ATIC等）へ配布され、1006th AISSのMajor H. W. Holmesに連絡があり、AF Form 112到着を待って予備調査を進める旨が記録されている。
summaryEn: Headquarters Fifteenth Air Force filed an AF Form 112/112A reporting that civilian James S. Hilbe observed an unidentified flying object near Upland, California on two mornings, about 5 and 6 September 1957 (approximately 1215Z–1230Z). Observations were ground-based, naked-eye. Each sighting involved a single object; shape, size and color are listed as unknown; no tail/exhaust and no sound were reported. Altitude is noted as about 2,000 feet. Speed, direction and maneuvers are unspecified. No physical evidence was available and the information was deemed inadequate for analysis. Captain Scarpero telephoned the headquarters; Major H. W. Holmes (1006th AISS) was notified and indicated he would begin a preliminary investigation pending receipt of the AF Form 112. Copies were distributed to relevant commands (ADC, SAC, ATIC, etc.).
